## Parental OpControl 0.17.0

- **Luna AI**, a supervised study buddy for your child, with its own parent dashboard section.
- Per-child Luna pages show chats, usage, limits and the learner profile; the review page shows every chat, flagged messages and requests for more time.
- Two setup choices: **Setup A** with OpenRouter (recommended, zero data retention) or **Setup B** with another provider plus OpenAI moderation. Setup has its own test button; Luna stays off until a setup is saved and the test passes.
- Safety: every question and answer is checked by a moderation model, urgent messages raise an alert, and parents can read every chat. Under-13 families must use Setup B.
- New **Luna** moon in the child's Windows session: it sleeps in the top-left corner, wakes on hover, and never pops up on its own. Daily limits, schedules and locks apply to it too.
- The My OpControl window, tray and lock screen now use the Luna style (night sky / moon gray), with the shared theme kept in sync between Luna and My OpControl.
- Full English and Spanish (es-MX) interface, with neutral wording for children.
- The welcome popup now waits for the page, animates in and out, respects reduced motion, and keeps focus and Esc working.
- Luna AI remains **off for every child** after the update. Enable it per child only after adding a key and passing Test connection.
